verdict.summary: The release gui-bundle matrix now installs the exactly pinned wasm-pack 0.15.0 through a SHA-pinned, architecture-aware prebuilt installer, avoiding both source compilation and the x86_64-only action on ARM runners. The guardrail is job-scoped, ignores comments, validates an ARM row and exact/version-unified pins, and includes meaningful mutation cases for both prohibited regressions. The focused test suite passes all 17 tests.
